zh: n. 自行车，脚踏车，单车
en: a bicycle
ex: One presenter went by bike.

en: a vehicle for travelling on water
ex: The last one travelled by speedboat up the River Thames.

en: a large vehicle in which people are driven from one place to another
ex: I go to school by bus.

en: a road vehicle with an engine, four wheels, and seats for a small number of people
ex: One went by car.

zh: 地铁：城市轨道交通系统中的一种列车，通常在地下运行。
en: a train that travels in tunnels beneath a city
ex: He took the underground train.

en: a boat that regularly carries passengers and often vehicles across an area of water
ex: a car ferry

en: an aircraft which flies using long, thin parts on top of it that turn round and round very fast
ex: The injured were flown to hospital by helicopter.

zh: 摩托车（尤指较小或较轻型的摩托车）
en: a vehicle with two wheels and an engine
ex: My cousin rides a motorbike.

zh: 平的，平坦的；二维平面的，二维空间的
en: a vehicle that flies and has at least one engine and wings
ex: We visit them every year and, of course, we go by plane.

zh: n. 出租车，计程车，的士
en: a car with a driver who you pay to take you somewhere
ex: I took a taxi from the station to the hotel.

en: a long, thin vehicle which travels along metal tracks and carries people or goods
ex: We always go by train.

en: a raised part of the Earth's surface, much larger than a hill, the top of which might be covered in snow
ex: My favourite journey is to the mountains to ski.

en: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea
ex: It’s got really beautiful beaches and we always have a great time.

en: a long, natural area of water that flows across the land and into a sea, lake, or another river
ex: Every morning I walk across the fields and then along the river.

en: a large area of salt water
ex: Every year my family goes on holiday to a small town by the sea.

en: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals
ex: corn fields

en: a large area of water which has land all around it
ex: Lake Titicaca is a large lake between Peru and Bolivia.

zh: 农场，养殖场；农舍；生产企业
en: an area of land with fields and buildings, used for growing crops and/or keeping animals as a business
ex: We live on a farm and my school is about one kilometre away.

zh: 森林，林区；（森林似的）一丛，一片；御猎场
en: a large area of trees growing closely together
ex: I just love watching the mountains and forests go past.

zh: 缆车，空中缆车；<美>有轨缆车（尤指旧金山等地的传统有轨缆车，常称叮当车）
en: a vehicle that hangs from thick cables and carries people up hills and mountains
ex: Ankara’s cable car is cheaper than other forms of public transport.

en: moving stairs that take people from one level of a building to another
ex: Escalators are usually inside a shopping centre or an airport.

zh: 潜艇，潜水艇；<美>潜艇三明治，长卷三明治；海底生物
en: a boat that travels under water
ex: Now you can travel in a submarine!
